method: Direct inspection of these exact, unmodified native runtime PNGs

SM5 after streaming return: facade, hazard strips, switch, debris and player remain visible. Shadows are softer and the existing threat-counter text is cramped.

limits: Selected stills and gross pixel-delta checks do not establish continuous fine ghosting/disocclusion quality.
Gray unfinished workshop geometry, empty dark world margins and existing UI spacing remain visible.
This is representative runtime integration, not final art acceptance or a cold packaged build.
